about: Difficulty levels for Env().reset(seed, config); load them with auditgym.levels.load(name). Only documented config keys within documented limits (config.py, limits.py); every level also stays inside the case ranges (200-2000 postings, 20-200 documents, 0-12 errors; python -m tools.case_ranges). Measured by tools/levels.py; table in docs/RESULTS.md.

easy.note: two error types, small books, one foreign currency, one month

medium.note: all four types twice, default-sized books, one foreign currency

hard.note: 12 issues: all four types plus interaction I1, two currencies, two months, large ledger (still within the case ranges)

max.note: the hardest level inside the case ranges: 12 issues with interaction I2, three currencies, three months, the longest ledger (about 1 800 postings, at most 200 documents); full read needs the most pages
